issue.observed: Native panel displayed only one old validation recording and no current greeting trace
issue.cause: Catalog and event parser accepted only schema 1. Real desktop recordings use schema 2; catalog silently ignored them.
issue.preliminaryDiagnosisCorrection: The earlier catalog-only check could not see schema-2 data. Raw manifest inspection confirmed that recordings had already been produced.

fixes: Accept schemas 1 and 2 and require every event to match its manifest version
Surface unsupported formats and counts instead of treating them as absent recordings
An empty bound-chat refresh matches its own newest readable recording, never an unrelated latest task
Only show recording setup when the path is not configured; use desktop guidance for a native macOS panel
Label an open trace session as recording rather than implying the model is still executing

validation.liveSchema2RequestComparison: Three sampled requests in the real current chat matched official input-item counts after excluding additional_tools.
